From c7d2f89fea26c84d5accc55d9976dd7e5305e63a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shin'ichiro Kawasaki <shinichiro.kawasaki@wdc.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Apr 2022 16:56:36 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] bus: fsl-mc-msi: Fix MSI descriptor mutex lock for
 msi_first_desc()

Commit e8604b1447b4 introduced a call to the helper function
msi_first_desc(), which needs MSI descriptor mutex lock before
call. However, the required mutex lock was not added. This results in
lockdep assertion:

 WARNING: CPU: 4 PID: 119 at kernel/irq/msi.c:274 msi_first_desc+0xd0/0x10c
  msi_first_desc+0xd0/0x10c
  fsl_mc_msi_domain_alloc_irqs+0x7c/0xc0
  fsl_mc_populate_irq_pool+0x80/0x3cc

Fix this by adding the mutex lock and unlock around the function call.

Fixes: e8604b1447b4 ("bus: fsl-mc-msi: Simplify MSI descriptor handling")
Signed-off-by: Shin'ichiro Kawasaki <shinichiro.kawasaki@wdc.com>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Damien Le Moal <damien.lemoal@opensource.wdc.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220412075636.755454-1-shinichiro.kawasaki@wdc.com

diff --git a/drivers/bus/fsl-mc/fsl-mc-msi.c b/drivers/bus/fsl-mc/fsl-mc-msi.c
index 5e0e4393ce4d..0cfe859a4ac4 100644
--- a/drivers/bus/fsl-mc/fsl-mc-msi.c
+++ b/drivers/bus/fsl-mc/fsl-mc-msi.c
@@ -224,8 +224,12 @@ int fsl_mc_msi_domain_alloc_irqs(struct device *dev,  unsigned int irq_count)
 	if (error)
 		return error;
 
+	msi_lock_descs(dev);
 	if (msi_first_desc(dev, MSI_DESC_ALL))
-		return -EINVAL;
+		error = -EINVAL;
+	msi_unlock_descs(dev);
+	if (error)
+		return error;
 
 	/*
 	 * NOTE: Calling this function will trigger the invocation of the
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/bus/fsl-mc/fsl-mc-msi.c`**
- Added a call to `msi_lock_descs(dev);` before the call to `msi_first_desc(dev, MSI_DESC_ALL)`.
- Introduced a variable `error` to store the result of the `msi_first_desc` call.
- Added a call to `msi_unlock_descs(dev);` after checking the result of `msi_first_desc`.
- The return statement for the error condition was modified to return `error` instead of directly returning `-EINVAL`.

### Relationships
The modifications in the file are aimed at fixing a bug related to mutex locking around the `msi_first_desc()` function call. The patch ensures that the necessary mutex lock is acquired before calling `msi_first_desc()` and released afterward, preventing potential race conditions and addressing a lockdep assertion warning. This change is directly related to the previous commit (e8604b1447b4) that simplified MSI descriptor handling, which inadvertently omitted the required mutex lock.
